description: Compute a content-hash ETag for the given content: digest it with MD5, SHA-1, or SHA-256, hex-encode it, and quote it into the exact string an ETag response header expects, with an optional weak-validator (W/) prefix. Hashes whatever content you give it; does not replicate any specific web server's own size/modification-time-based ETag algorithm.

content.description: The content to hash into an ETag

weak.description: Whether to produce a weak validator (W/ prefix)

name: generate_etag
